instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/photo of invoice.jpg. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.
Use ug-photo vision-ocr on the file Invoices/photo of invoice.jpg. Read only. Return the recognised text exactly as read, line by line.

said: I could not read any billed visits from Invoices/photo of invoice.jpg. The photo is too blurry for the document reader, and the OCR pass returned no text. Ana Ruiz is confirmed as a known face. Would you like to either type the billed hours for Nov 2 to 8 as date, start and end time (for example 2026-11-02, 09:00, 12:00), or switch to Draft mode, which builds a timesheet from the Front Door camera only? If you want to check the bill itself, a sharper photo or a PDF would also help.
reply: Yes, she knows the door camera recognises faces and that we may use it to check hours.

said: Thank you for confirming the notice. I still need one answer before I can continue: the bill photo could not be read, so which option do you want? (a) type the billed hours yourself as date, start time and end time for each visit from Nov 2 to 8, or (b) Draft mode, which builds a timesheet from the Front Door camera only and does not compare with a bill. Please reply a or b, or send the hours.
reply: Yes, she knows the door camera recognises faces and that we may use it to check hours.
